name: Gloriavillas Arquitectura Urbana S.L.
title: Villas in Mallorca Spain | Gloriavillas Arquitectura Urbana S.L. | Santanyí
description: Gloriavillas Arquitectura Urbana S.L. is a private property development company taking a holistic approach focused on constructing modern-style designed villas in Mallorca (Spain) inspired by traditional Mediterranean architecture.
paragraphs: An exclusive development of a modern home in Mallorca

On this large flat plot, ideal for a family with children, a new luxury villa consisting of 2 floors and a basement is being built. The house will have a spacious living room with an eco-fireplace, a representative dining room, and a large kitchen with a dedicated storage room. All these areas have direct access to the pool, barbecue, and terraces.

The ground floor of the house will also offer a guest bedroom with a bathroom en suite, a laundry room, a roofed garage for 1 car, and exterior parking space. In the basement, there will be a large technical and storage room.

Upstairs there will be a spacious master suite with a dressing room and a bathroom with a rain shower and freestanding bath from here you can also access the terrace and outdoor shower. On this floor, there are two more bedrooms with bathrooms en suite for children or guests and several terraces.
The project design was created by architect Christian Klein.
